title: Rosa Parks
summary: Born in Tuskegee, Alabama, in 1913, she grew up in Montgomery and joined its NAACP chapter in 1943. Arrested there on 1 December 1955 for refusing to give up her bus seat to a white passenger, she became the spark for the Montgomery bus boycott, a 13-month protest led by Martin Luther King Jr. that helped end bus segregation. She later moved to Detroit and died in 2005 aged 92.

uncertainty.note: Birth day and arrest day are stated by the sources; death given only as month and year.
